scheme_name: Dr.Babasaheb Ambedkar Udyog Uday Yojana: Assistance to basic industrial infrastructure (Water, Gas and Approach Road)
other_conditions: The firm must be a Micro, Small or Medium enterprise (MSME).
The enterprise must be run by an SC or ST entrepreneur, with SC/ST contribution of at least 51%.
The applicant must have made a fixed capital investment in industrial infrastructure such as an approach road, water supply, or gas facilities.
The infrastructure should be developed outside GIDC areas or industrial parks.
Approach road construction must be certified for quality by a government‑approved third party.
Expenditures on water/gas connections must be for connecting the industrial unit from the source.
benefits_summary: Provides up to 75% of the cost of capital investment for water, gas or approach road infrastructure, with a maximum assistance of ₹15,00,000.
